confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are medium confidence: they come from aggregator, crowd-sourced and guide figures that disagree by about 10-20% and are not dated to July 2026. Cocktail and wine are lower confidence, based on a few guide and crowd-sourced figures, with beer used as a cross-check. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings or current booking pages. CAD-to-USD conversion uses an assumed rate of about 0.73, not a searched rate. The FX observation is not the latest available as of 2026-10-16: the only RBA figure surfaced was a 2026-03-20 snapshot from search-result text, which I did not confirm by opening the RBA page. Treat fx as stale until refreshed from the RBA F11.1 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Food and drink anchors are Vancouver-specific, converted from CAD at an assumed rate of about 0.73 USD per CAD. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates for Vancouver in July peak season, from general knowledge and the supplied context only.
